title: 中国人民银行副行长陈德霖：香港将推离岸人民币期货，黄金市场互联互通
speaker: Chen Derling

segments.en: In the next stage, PBOC will work closely with the demand of the market, make Hong Kong more diversified. Hong Kong will be an international hub of the asset management and wealth management. First, Hong Kong will issue the offshore RMB future. For soon, Hong Kong will issue 5-year RMB futures. That offers a unique risk-atch.
segments.zh: 下一阶段，人民银行将贴近市场需求，推动香港多元化，成为国际资产和财富管理中心。香港将推出离岸人民币期货，很快将发行5年期人民币期货，提供独特风险对冲工具。

segments.en: Second, Hong Kong will develop a comprehensive trading platform of foreign currencies. PBOC is working with the FIC and Hong Kong M&A to upload the bond connect to be a platform. That will be a crucial contribution to the infrastructure. It offers the infrastructure service to use foreign reserves exchanges and bond exchanges. The collateral products will be expanded.
segments.zh: 第二，香港将发展综合外汇交易平台。人民银行正与金管局等升级债券通为平台，提供外汇和债券交易基础设施，并扩大抵押品范围。

segments.en: Therefore, Hong Kong's gold market will be developed further. The gold market of Hong Kong and the mainland China will be connected further. Just now, the CE announced the outline of the gold market development in Hong Kong. PBOC will be actively support Hong Kong's initiative. In the first stage, PBOC got the Shanghai gold exchange to set up the first warehouse of the transaction in Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 因此，香港黄金市场将进一步发展，与内地市场互联互通。行政长官刚宣布了香港黄金市场发展大纲，人民银行将积极支持，已推动上海黄金交易所在港设立首个交割仓库。
